about_the_game:
Brass & Bramble is a narrative deck-builder set in an alternate steampunk Victorian age where myth and empire collide. Step into the role of Avalon’s Envoy, wielding your deck to battle the British Empire’s brass-forged legions across the globe, grow your bonds with mythological legends, and rebuild Avalon as your home base.

Build your deck, choose your companions, and decide the future of Avalon.

Features

  • Narrative Card Battler – Tactical card combat interwoven with story encounters. Experience an epic handcrafted story while uncovering unique personal arcs for each Legend you rescue.

  • Legend Companions – Recruit mythical Legends from around the world. Each brings distinct abilities, cards, building upgrades, and relics that expand as your bond deepens.

  • Expedition System – Select up to three Legends to join you on each expedition. Explore the forests of Ireland to the deserts of Egypt to the jungles of India and many more, facing enemies, gathering relics, and rescuing new allies.

  • Dynamic Replayability – No two expeditions unfold the same. Brass & Bramble follows an evolving story rather than a roguelike loop with a shifting pool of events, challenges, and discoveries that keeps every journey fresh and unpredictable.

  • Deckbuilding & Progression – Earn and refine cards through victories, story events, and Legend bonds. Craft strategies around synergies between companions, relics and more.

  • Rebuild Avalon – Restore Avalon as your stronghold between expeditions. Upgrading it unlocks resources, features, and narrative choices that fuel your campaign.
